notes: Version 2, Nov 23 2026 (R442): Astra's hull with the Opus fittings. Built from the build sheet docs/ship_pipeline/build_sheets/hegemony_H7/ (design file tools/blender/build_sheets/ships/hegemony_H7.py; issue 1412). The sheet is the one home of the design (RULEBOOK 0.9, R225): masses, parts, mounts, seams, insides, hard points and the ship length (LENGTH 6.5, the Frigate class length) come from it through tools/blender/build_sheets/contract.py; this file only names the sheet, the game ids, the concept and the recipe settings. Concept: Muse run 3 Picket (issue 1146, PR 1707), picked by Ryan Nov 22 2026 with the keel flattened. game_code H7_23 is the Frigate folder the game picks for hegemony (godot/render/hull_table.gd AI_HULLS); an install replaces the old hull there, copied aside first. bake stack: stage 5 paints it with the Hegemony kit's paint stack (tools/blender/kits/hegemony/stack.py, through tools/blender/r209/bake_sheet.py).
